tag: 旅館設施導覽與營業時間更正

level.why: 有 however 轉折，需對照圖表營業時間與口頭更正，含推論題

script.t: Welcome to the Harborview Hotel, and thank you for joining our morning tour of the property.
script.zh: 歡迎來到港景飯店，感謝大家參加我們的早晨館內導覽。

script.t: We will start here at the front desk, where our concierge can help with maps and tickets.
script.zh: 我們從這裡的櫃檯開始，禮賓人員可以協助地圖和票券。

script.t: On the third floor, you will find our spa, which normally closes at eight p.m.
script.zh: 三樓是我們的水療中心，平常晚上八點關門。

script.t: However, it will close at five o'clock today because of a private wedding party.
script.zh: 然而，今天因為有私人婚宴，會在五點關門。

script.t: The business center on the second floor is open until six, and printing is free for guests.
script.zh: 二樓的商務中心開到六點，住客列印免費。

script.t: If you prefer fresh air, the rooftop bar on the twelfth floor opens at five and has a great city view.
script.zh: 如果您想吹吹風，十二樓的頂樓酒吧五點開放，有很棒的城市景觀。

script.t: Please note that guests must be twenty-one or older to enter the bar.
script.zh: 請注意，賓客必須年滿二十一歲才能進入酒吧。

script.t: Breakfast is available every morning on the first floor, but it ends at ten, so please don't be late.
script.zh: 每天早上一樓都有早餐，但十點結束，所以請別太晚。

script.t: That brings us to the end of our tour, so please feel free to ask me any questions.
script.zh: 導覽到此結束，歡迎隨時向我提問。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Which facility can a guest use at 7 p.m. today?
q.zh: 請看圖表。住客今天晚上七點可以使用哪項設施？

choices.why: 酒吧下午五點開到晚上十一點。
圖表寫到八點，但今天因婚宴五點就關門。
商務中心六點關門。
早餐只到早上十點。

q.t: What can be inferred about the rooftop bar?
q.zh: 關於頂樓酒吧，可以推論什麼？

choices.t: A nineteen-year-old guest cannot enter it.
choices.zh: 十九歲的住客不能進入。
choices.why: 必須年滿二十一歲才能進入。

choices.t: It is closed for a wedding party.
choices.why: 因婚宴提早關門的是水療中心。
免費列印的是商務中心。

choices.t: It is on the second floor.
choices.why: 酒吧在十二樓。

q.t: What does the speaker invite the guests to do?
q.zh: 說話者邀請客人做什麼？

choices.why: feel free to ask me any questions。
水療中心今天會提早關門，且她沒有邀請大家現在去。
地圖是禮賓人員可協助的項目，列印則是商務中心的服務。
她只提醒早餐十點結束。

tag: 智慧溫控器免費提供方案新聞

level.why: 先說限舊大樓再更正為全面開放，有 however 轉折，含意圖題

script.t: Turning now to news about your home, Brightline Power has announced a program to cut electric bills.
script.zh: 現在來看與您家有關的新聞，光線電力宣布了一項降低電費的方案。

script.t: Starting next month, the company will give away free smart thermostats to one hundred thousand households.
script.zh: 從下個月開始，公司將免費送出十萬個智慧溫控器給家庭。

script.t: The company first said only customers in older buildings could join, but it has now opened the program to everyone.
script.zh: 公司起初說只有舊大樓的客戶可以參加，但現在已開放給所有人。

script.t: A thermostat can lower heating and cooling costs by about ten percent, according to the company.
script.zh: 根據公司說法，溫控器可降低約百分之十的冷暖氣費用。

script.t: However, customers must apply online before the end of June to receive one.
script.zh: 然而，客戶必須在六月底前線上申請才能領取。

script.t: Installation is free, and a technician will visit within two weeks.
script.zh: 安裝免費，技師會在兩週內到府。

script.t: Some people worry that the devices are hard to use.
script.zh: 有些人擔心這些裝置很難操作。

script.t: In response, Brightline says its staff will show each customer how to set the schedule.
script.zh: 對此，光線電力表示員工會教每位客戶如何設定時程。

script.t: That's the latest in household news, and we'll have more after the break.
script.zh: 這是最新的居家新聞，廣告後還有更多。

q.t: What is the report mainly about?
q.zh: 這則報導主要是關於什麼？

choices.t: A free program to help lower electric bills
choices.zh: 協助降低電費的免費方案
choices.why: 免費送出智慧溫控器以降低電費。
方案是要降低電費。
線上只是申請方式。

choices.t: A guide to fixing old buildings
choices.why: 舊大樓只是原先限制的條件。

q.t: Who can join the program now?
q.zh: 現在誰可以參加這個方案？

choices.why: opened the program to everyone。
這是原先的規定，現已取消。
技師只負責安裝。

choices.t: Only people who applied last June
choices.zh: 只有去年六月申請的人
choices.why: 申請期限是今年六月底前。

q.t: Why does the reporter say, "Some people worry that the devices are hard to use"?
q.zh: 記者為什麼說「Some people worry that the devices are hard to use」？

choices.t: To introduce a concern the company has answered
choices.zh: 引出公司已回應的疑慮
choices.why: 下一句公司表示會教客戶設定。

choices.t: To say the program should end
choices.why: 他沒有表達這種立場。

choices.t: To explain how to apply online
choices.why: 申請方式已在前面說過。

choices.t: To say that installation costs money
choices.why: 安裝是免費的。

tag: 客房冷氣故障改房通知留言

level.why: 有 however 轉折，需理解提議背後的原因，含推論題

script.t: Hello, Mr. Dawson, Nora here at the Grand Palm Hotel, calling about your stay next week.
script.zh: 您好，道森先生，我是大棕櫚飯店的諾拉，來電關於您下週的住宿。

script.t: You booked a double room with an ocean view for three nights, starting on Tuesday.
script.zh: 您訂了一間有海景的雙人房，從週二開始住三晚。

script.t: Unfortunately, the air conditioning in that room is broken, and the repair will not be done by then.
script.zh: 很遺憾，那間房的冷氣壞了，而且到時修不好。

script.t: I would like to move you to a suite on the same floor, which is larger than your original room.
script.zh: 我想把您換到同樓層的套房，比您原本的房間大。

script.t: However, the suite faces the garden, not the ocean.
script.zh: 然而，這間套房面向花園，而不是海。

script.t: If the garden view is a problem, we can reduce your price by fifteen percent.
script.zh: 如果花園景觀有問題，我們可以把您的價格減少百分之十五。

script.t: Our airport pickup service is still available, and it can be arranged at the front desk.
script.zh: 我們的機場接送服務仍可使用，可在櫃檯安排。

script.t: Please call me back by Friday so that I can confirm the room.
script.zh: 請在週五前回電，讓我確認房間。

script.t: Thank you, and we look forward to seeing you.
script.zh: 謝謝您，期待您的光臨。

q.t: Who most likely is the speaker?

choices.why: 她代表飯店通知住客改房。
機場接送只是飯店的服務之一。
維修是另一位人員負責，她並未說要修理。
她說的是 our hotel 的服務。

q.t: What does the speaker say about the suite?
q.zh: 說話者提到這間套房的什麼？

choices.t: It is bigger than the original room.
choices.why: larger than your original room。
套房面向花園。

choices.t: It is on a different floor.
choices.why: 套房在同一樓層。
壞掉的是原本的房間。

q.t: Why does the speaker offer to reduce the price?
q.zh: 說話者為什麼提議降價？

choices.t: Mr. Dawson may not like the garden view.
choices.zh: 道森先生可能不喜歡花園景觀。
choices.why: 套房沒有海景，所以提供價格優惠。
獨白沒有提到客滿。

choices.t: Mr. Dawson asked for his money back.
choices.why: 獨白沒有提到他要求退款。
機場接送仍可使用。
